prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” interior painting company for everyone — the right choice depends on your budget, timeline, the rooms/finish you want, and whether you need additional prep (repairs, trim work, mildew treatment, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. To start, tell me any of the following:

- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in St. Louis
- Type of job (whole house, one room, condo, rental, commercial)
- Budget or target timeline
- Any must-haves (EPA lead-safe, low-VOC paint, color consultation, warranty)

If you want to choose one yourself right now, here’s a quick, reliable process and what to look for:

1. Gather 3–4 bids
   - Compare written estimates, not just verbal quotes.
   - Make sure each includes prep work, number of coats, paint brand/type, trim work, cleanup, and timeline.

2. Verify credentials
   - Confirm insurance (general liability and workers’ comp).
   - Ask about licensing if applicable and whether they follow EPA lead-safe practices for older homes.

3. Check reputation
   - Read recent Google and Yelp reviews and ask for 2–3 local references (similar scope of work).
   - Look at before/after photos or a portfolio.

4. Ask the right questions
   - Which paint brand and sheen do you recommend and why?
   - How do you protect floors/furniture and minimize dust?
   - What’s your touch-up/warranty policy?
   - Who will be on-site and how long will it take?

5. Evaluate professionalism and communication
   - A prompt, detailed written estimate and clear project timeline are good signs.

If you like, give me your ZIP code and some details about the job and I’ll suggest a few well-reviewed local companies in St. Louis and help you draft questions or compare estimates.
